verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog, feedback and roadmap tool, so short-name navigation to feedback items or roadmap entries is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents feedback collection and public/private roadmaps but never mentions short identifiers or quick-jump navigation to items, tasks or initiatives.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
